summary.text: Robert Stivers is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 25, serving since 1997. The legislature's profile lists Stivers as Senate President and chair of the Committee on Committees and the Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Robert Stivers was born on December 24, 1961, and is an attorney.
The profile lists a B.S. in industrial management from the University of Kentucky and a J.D. from the University of Louisville.
It also lists his service as chair of the Council of State Governments and of the Southern Legislative Conference, and as Majority Floor Leader from 2009 to 2012.
